g.text: POST /api/ai-agents-teams/{address}/{id}/publish-to-firesky/prepare + /send — give a deployed team a social account
create or log into the account
record naming the CURRENT deployment URI
The prepare request carries PDS credentials
(email, password, optional invite code) to the
service. What reaches the chain is an encrypted
per-publication app password, never the account
password; still, treat this endpoint as a
credential boundary and only ever call it over
HTTPS against a service you trust.
Publication is keyed by DEPLOYMENT URI, not team
id: the config record names whichever deployment
was current at publish time. Re-deploying mints
a new URI, which is what published-state's
